queries.label: Port-delay analysis
queries.sql: SELECT "p"."id" AS "port_id", "p"."name" AS "port_name", AVG("s"."delay_hours") AS "avg_delay_hours" FROM "vault_data"."shipments" AS "s" JOIN "vault_data"."ports" AS "p" ON "s"."port_id" = "p"."id" WHERE "s"."shipped_on" >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND "s"."shipped_on" <= CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY "p"."id", "p"."name" ORDER BY "avg_delay_hours" DESC LIMIT 100
queries.decision: The query selects the average delay per port for all shipments in October 2026, grouping by port and ordering by the average delay in descending order. It limits the result to 100 rows as requested.

queries.label: October shipment count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments WHERE shipped_on >= '2026-10-01' AND shipped_on < '2026-11-01'
